title: Tell it in the past
objective: Use the past simple to talk about a completed experience.
notes: A finished action in the past uses a past verb form.
Regular verbs often end in -ed; common irregular verbs change form.
examples: We went to a small café yesterday.

questions.explanation: Yesterday tells us the action is finished, so use explored.

questions.prompt: Last weekend, we ___ to the coast.
questions.explanation: Went is the past form of go.

title: A travel story
objective: Put past actions in a clear sequence.
notes: Start with when and where the story happened.
Use then and after that to connect events.
examples: Last year, I travelled to Hamburg. Then I visited the harbour.
We arrived late, but we found a lovely hotel.

questions.prompt: Choose the natural next sentence: We arrived at noon. ___
questions.explanation: Then connects the next completed event in a story.

title: First introductions
objective: Introduce yourself and ask someone where they are from.
notes: Ich heiße … means My name is …
Woher kommst du? asks where someone comes from in an informal conversation.
examples: Ich komme aus Frankreich. Und du?

questions.explanation: Ich heiße means My name is.

questions.prompt: How do you ask informally, Where are you from?
questions.explanation: Woher asks about origin; kommst du means do you come.

title: Finding your way
objective: Ask politely for directions in town.
notes: Entschuldigung is a polite way to get attention.
examples: Gehen Sie geradeaus und dann links.

questions.prompt: Choose the polite question for the station.
questions.explanation: Wo ist …? asks where a place is.
